items.why: Steepest chip selloff of the day as AI debt fears intensify. The FT and Reuters report global chip stocks sinking on worries about AI spending funded by debt.
Leading chip stocks lower as the AI trade takes a hit, per Yahoo Finance. The broad selloff in chipmakers is the day's dominant theme.
Sliding with high beta tech after hot September CPI revived rate hike fears. Traders eye tonight's Roadster event at 7:55pm CT, a week before Q3 earnings on Oct. 21.
Nasdaq heavyweights under pressure as hot inflation data stirs rate hike worries, per Reuters, with inflation anxiety dragging on AI stocks for a second day.

market_note: Futures were mixed to lower; the 10-year yield spiked on hot September CPI before easing back toward 5.04%.
summary: Chips lead the tape lower as AI debt fears collide with hot September inflation data. The Nasdaq is down hard while the Dow holds up, and gold is catching the safety bid.
